contracts.commit_point: Tool dispatch: the before_tool_callback decision point, where validate_tool_call returns a block dict (execution short-circuited) or None (tool body allowed to execute).
contracts.declared_mechanism: domain_safety_guard (app/safety.py:174-176) registered as before_tool_callback on all four agents, delegating to PolicyService.validate_tool_call, which calls is_tool_allowed(agent_name, tool.name) against policies.yaml and returns a blocked dict for unauthorized combinations; transfer_to_agent is always allowed (app/safety.py:52-54).
contracts.forbidden_condition: A tool function executing for an agent whose role's allowed_tools list (app/policies.yaml roles section) does not contain that tool; validate_tool_call must return a 'blocked' Security Guardrail dict for such unauthorized role-tool combinations.

Whether tool_context.agent_name always equals the configured role names for every invocation path (including sub-agent flows via transfer_to_agent) is not established in supplied source; validate_tool_call falls back to 'root_agent' when agent_name is empty (app/safety.py:120).
contracts.protected_operation: ADK tool invocation/execution dispatched by the four registered agents (scout_agent: app/agent.py:101-112; analyst_agent: app/agent.py:115-130; db_analyst_agent: app/agent.py:133-145; coordinator_agent: app/agent.py:153-181).

contracts.protection_obligation: Every tool invocation on the scout_agent, analyst_agent, db_analyst_agent, and coordinator_agent must pass through the registered domain_safety_guard before_tool_callback and may execute only if the invoking agent's role allowlist in app/policies.yaml authorizes that tool.
scope_limits: Enforcement keys on tool_context.agent_name (app/safety.py:120); calls to the underlying functions in app/tools.py or app/mcp_server.py that bypass ADK tool dispatch are not gated.
transfer_to_agent bypasses role checks by design (app/safety.py:52-54).

This single gate is the only declared control in supplied source restricting save_intelligence_report's file/database writes (app/tools.py:77-96, 127, 142-150) and post_slack_notification's webhook POST (app/tools.py:221-227) to coordinator_agent; no dedicated per-effect guard exists for those tools.
If policies.yaml fails to load, PolicyService falls back to empty roles/security config (app/safety.py:30-38), changing which role-tool combinations are allowed.
The guard also resolves [[VARIABLE]] placeholders in tool args before the authorization check (app/safety.py:129-132); that context-hygiene behavior is not asserted as a forbidden condition here.
